args.Rationale: With Russia now bordering us after capturing Cologne and possessing overwhelming military might, we must adopt a cautious posture. Lowering WarBias and HostileBias prevents reckless aggression, while maximizing GuardedBias and AfraidBias ensures we respect the Russian threat and prioritize survival. A slight increase in FriendlyBias helps preserve relations with neutrals.

Russia is an existential military threat with 15k strength and a new border at Cologne. Reducing our hostility modifier from -95 to -30 signals to our staff that we should avoid provocation and seek to de-escalate while we fortify for a potential invasion.

The Inca are militarily exhausted and being dismantled by Russia. There is little gain in continuing this war. Easing our hostility should allow our diplomats to seek a white peace so we can redirect all resources to the Russian frontier.
Venice is a broken vassal of the Inca with no military power. Maintaining extreme hostility is pointless. A modest negative stance keeps pressure low so we can disengage cleanly.

Satellites unlock the Apollo Program, which is mandatory for the Science Victory. With Russia already in the Information Era, we are in a race against time. We must pivot our research toward spaceship components immediately after Computers.

Enlightenment grants a free technology and happiness from Universities. The free tech will either save us a dozen turns on Satellites or let us grab a critical military/defensive technology. This is far more valuable than Futurism for our Spaceship strategy.
